meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把 Matrix 频道适配器复制进项目的 src/channels/、注册进频道入口、按固定版本装好依赖、给 matrix-js-sdk 打 ESM 补丁,再跑构建和注册测试;还会引导你创建独立的机器人账号并填写连接凭据。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 支持 Matrix 聊天、需要接入 Matrix 频道时,这个技能会接管适配、依赖和凭据配置的步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道接入进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖、打补丁并跑构建与测试

say.text: 用用户名密码的方式配置 Matrix 机器人凭据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the Matrix adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then runs the build and registration test. It also walks you through creating a separate bot account and filling in credentials.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw to support Matrix chat and need the Matrix channel wired in; the skill handles the adapter, dependencies, and credential setup.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, patches, builds and tests

say_en.text: Set up the Matrix bot credentials with username and password
say_en.note: Asks for homeserver URL, user ID, username, password

say_en.text: Run the matrix-registration test to check Matrix is registered
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted
